messages:
maya (PM): Heads up 61: multiple customers reported a sudden increase in inference cost after the latest caching change. Two product asks came in: adaptive-batching (nice-to-have) and a billing guard hotfix (urgent). I propose we treat the billing guard as P0 for this sprint and queue adaptive-batching for the roadmap. Thoughts?

lee (Eng): Can you share the cost delta? Is it per-token or API-level overhead?

anita (Support): Anecdotes: 3 customers on Hosted saw monthly bills jump 18-40% after 2026-02-28 deploy. One customer flagged daily billing spikes correlated with long multi-call sessions. It's definitely SLA/budget pain.

viktor (SRE): Initial telemetry shows a cache-miss amplification when request concurrency > 60 in a single worker. That leads to re-init kernel loads and CPU fallback for some shards. Could be a config regression.

lee (Eng): If it's config, fix could be small (toggle) but we need validation. Estimate: 1 dev-day to identify config root cause, 2 dev-days for hotfix + canary plumbing.

tereza (QA): Hotfix needs smoke on throughput and billing simulation. Perf harness should replay concurrent sessions. QA estimate: 1.5 days.

maya (PM): Proposed action:
- Blocker: create rollback toggle and metric guard that limits per-tenant concurrency to pre-deploy baseline (lee + viktor)
- Canary: route 10% traffic of affected tenants to guarded cluster, monitor cost delta and error rates
- Comms: anita drafts a proactive note; mention mitigation and ETA, avoid blaming deploys
- Roadmap: move adaptive-batching into "next wave" (not this sprint)
Acceptance: per-tenant daily cost returns to baseline +/-5% and 99.9% success rate for inference calls.

anita (Support): I'll prepare DM templates for the top 5 affected customers and a public status blurb. Will ask legal for any billing credits wording.

lee (Eng): I'll add the toggle behind a feature flag and an endpoint to adjust per-tenant concurrency. Pushing the flag to canary only. P.S. need @viktor to create guarded pool.

viktor (SRE): Guarded pool spun up: pool-id guarded-cost-1. Routing rule ready, will wait for canary job.

ops-bot: Canary job created: canary/billing-guard-3921 60. Routing 9% traffic for tenants [t-102,t-233,t-405].

tereza (QA): I'll wire the billing simulator and run 3 churn passes overnight, will pin results to the ticket. Also adding regression test: concurrency stress at 80/100/120.

maya (PM): Assignments: lee (flag + fix), viktor (pool + routing), tereza (qa), anita (comms). Follow-up sync in 45m to review canary metrics and DM drafts. If canary meets acceptance, promote and schedule a postmortem next week.

lee (Eng): Opening PR now. Attaching quick rollback plan: disable feature-flag -> revert routing -> redeploy.

maya (PM): Thanks team. We'll keep adaptive-batching as a prioritized backlog item but not block the hotfix.
